name: Signal Transducer and Activator of Transcription 5B Deficiency
aliases: STAT5B Immunodeficiency and Growth Hormone Insensitivity

criteria.description: Identification of biallelic pathogenic STAT5B mutations by genetic testing
Clinical evidence of growth hormone insensitivity with short stature and low IGF-1 levels despite normal or elevated GH
Recurrent bacterial and viral infections with laboratory evidence of impaired cellular immunity
Presence of chronic or recurrent pulmonary infections or interstitial lung disease
Autoimmune manifestations such as eczema or autoimmune cytopenias

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of biallelic pathogenic STAT5B mutations plus clinical evidence of growth hormone insensitivity and immunodeficiency
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis is confirmed by genetic testing; clinical features support diagnosis and guide management.

pathognomonic.symptomName: Severe short stature due to growth hormone insensitivity
Recurrent severe bacterial and viral infections

common.symptomName: Eczema and other dermatological autoimmune manifestations

rare.symptomName: Neurological complications such as developmental delay
Pulmonary hypertension secondary to chronic lung disease

laboratory: Low serum IGF-1 despite normal or elevated growth hormone levels
imaging: Chest CT showing interstitial lung disease and fibrosis
Skeletal survey indicating delayed bone age
genetic: Biallelic pathogenic mutations in STAT5B gene confirmed by sequencing
other: Poor response to growth hormone therapy

distinguishingFeatures: GH receptor mutations rather than STAT5B mutations
More profound immunodeficiency with absent T and B cells

redFlags: Severe recurrent infections with opportunistic pathogens
Failure to respond to growth hormone therapy
Progressive respiratory failure due to interstitial lung disease
references: Kofoed EM, et al. STAT5B deficiency: clinical phenotype and molecular mechanisms. J Clin Endocrinol Metab. 2016.
Flanagan SE, et al. STAT5B mutations in growth hormone insensitivity and immune dysfunction. Nat Genet. 2018.
Orphanet: STAT5B deficiency. Orphanet Journal of Rare Diseases. 2020.
